name: registry-mcp
description: Company data for AI agents: Norway (Brønnøysundregistrene / brreg) and the UK (Companies House), read-only, one JSON shape.
long_description: registry-mcp is a read-only MCP server over national business registers: Norway's Enhetsregisteret (Brønnøysundregistrene, looked up by organisasjonsnummer/orgnr) and the United Kingdom's Companies House (looked up by company number). Five tools return one JSON shape across both countries: lookup_company, search_company, company_deadlines (statutory filing deadlines, cited to the rule that produced them), validate_company_id and list_countries. Nothing here writes to a register or anywhere else, and no caller credentials are required; this extension launches the published `registry-mcp` package with `uvx`, so no separate install step is needed beyond Python 3.12+ and uv.

companies_house_api_key.title: Companies House API key
companies_house_api_key.description: Enables United Kingdom (GB) lookups. Free and instant from developer.company-information.service.gov.uk. Leave blank to use Norway only — GB calls then return upstream_error naming this variable, and every other country keeps working.

contact_email.title: Contact email
contact_email.description: Sent in the User-Agent to the national registry, as Brønnøysundregistrene asks of API clients. Unset means an anonymous client, which may be throttled or blocked upstream.

cache_path.title: Cache file path
cache_path.description: Path to the local SQLite response cache (24 h TTL). Defaults to ./data/cache.sqlite3 if left blank.
